sections.content: Describe economic trends with parece que, se observa que, está aumentando and está disminuyendo. Give opinions with creo que, considero que and pienso que, then support them with a reason.

items.spanish: Se observa que los precios están aumentando.
items.english: It can be observed that prices are increasing.

items.spanish: Parece que el mercado está cambiando.
items.english: It seems that the market is changing.

items.spanish: Creo que el crecimiento es positivo.
Considero que la inflación afecta a muchas familias.
items.english: I consider that inflation affects many families.

sections.content: An economic opinion is stronger when you identify a trend and explain why you interpret it that way.
